title: CamelCase function and argument naming violating PEP 8
diff:
@@ -1,4 +1,4 @@
 from decimal import Decimal
 
-def calculate_balance_ratio(opening_balance: Decimal, net_turnover: Decimal) -> Decimal:
-    return net_turnover / opening_balance if opening_balance else Decimal("0")
+def CalculateBalanceRatio(OpeningBalance: Decimal, NetTurnover: Decimal) -> Decimal:
+    return NetTurnover / OpeningBalance if OpeningBalance else Decimal("0")

ground_truth.description: Function and parameter names use CamelCase instead of PEP 8 snake_case style.
